response.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0061"],
      "quote": "Information in a tender is confidential to the Council and its advisers, except where the law obliges the Council to publish it.",
      "statement": "Information in a tender is confidential to the Council and its advisers, except where the law obliges the Council to publish it; this states background confidentiality rules.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0062"],
      "quote": "The portal offers a test upload, through which bidders can check that their files open before they submit them.",
      "statement": "Bidders can check that their files open before they submit them using the test upload offered by the portal.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0063"],
      "quote": "The procurement team answers questions about the portal from 09:00 to 17:00 on Working Days.",
      "statement": "The procurement team answers questions about the portal from 09:00 to 17:00 on Working Days; this binds the procurement team, not the supplier.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0064"],
      "quote": "Bidders who have trouble with the portal close to the deadline can call the procurement team, which logs each call with its time.",
      "statement": "Bidders who have trouble with the portal close to the deadline can call the procurement team.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0065"],
      "quote": "Tenders must be submitted through the Halverton e-Tendering Portal by 12:00 GMT on 2027-01-15, and the portal accepts no upload after that time.",
      "statement": "Bidders must submit tenders through the Halverton e-Tendering Portal by 12:00 GMT on 2027-01-15.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0066"],
      "quote": "Bidders may ask clarification questions through the portal until 12:00 GMT on 2026-12-18.",
      "statement": "Bidders may ask clarification questions through the portal until 12:00 GMT on 2026-12-18.",
      "modality": "may",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0067"],
      "quote": "The Council publishes each answer to all bidders through the portal, without naming the bidder who asked.",
      "statement": "The Council publishes each answer to all bidders through the portal without naming the bidder who asked; this binds the Council.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0068"],
      "quote": "A tender consists of three files: the quality response, the completed price schedule in Annex C, and the Form of Tender in Annex D.",
      "statement": "A tender consists of three files: the quality response, the completed price schedule in Annex C, and the Form of Tender in Annex D.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0069"],
      "quote": "The Form of Tender must be signed by a director of the bidder and uploaded as a separate file, and a tender without it is rejected.",
      "statement": "The Form of Tender must be signed by a director of the bidder and uploaded as a separate file.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0070"],
      "quote": "The portal shows a receipt for each file once its upload is complete.",
      "statement": "The portal shows a receipt for each file once its upload is complete; this describes the portal's function.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0071"],
      "quote": "The quality response is one PDF file of at most 30 pages of A4, set in type of at least 11 points, and pages after the thirtieth are not read.",
      "statement": "The quality response is one PDF file of at most 30 pages of A4, set in type of at least 11 points.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0072"],
      "quote": "The quality response must not name the bidder, its staff, its subcontractors or its clients, so that evaluators can score it without knowing who wrote it.",
      "statement": "The quality response must not name the bidder, its staff, its subcontractors or its clients.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0073"],
      "quote": "A response that names any of them scores zero on the question concerned.",
      "statement": "A response that names any of them scores zero on the question concerned; this states a scoring consequence.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0074"],
      "quote": "If the tender documents conflict, they apply in this order: any addendum, the latest first; this document; Annex B; the other annexes.",
      "statement": "If the tender documents conflict, they apply in a specified order; this provides rules of interpretation.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BACKGROUND",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0075"],
      "quote": "The Council publishes any addendum on the portal at least ten days before the tender deadline.",
      "statement": "The Council publishes any addendum on the portal at least ten days before the tender deadline; this binds the Council.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
      "hazard": false
    }
  ],
  "no_obligation_src_ids": [
    "SRC-0076",
    "SRC-0077",
    "SRC-0078",
    "SRC-0079",
    "SRC-0080"
  ]
}
